follow-up time: From second trimester to third trimester
exposure: Distance of placenta overlying the internal os in the second trimester
distance of the placenta overlying the internal os
outcome: Persistence of placenta previa in the third trimester
cohort: 313 women with a placenta previa in the second trimester
finding: A larger distance of the placenta overlying the internal os in the second trimester, previous caesarean delivery, and conception with assisted reproductive technique were significantly associated with a higher risk of placenta previa persistence.
